title: Everybody, my & your, liaison
summary: With il/elle the verbs end in a silent t: il veut, elle peut, il doit. tout le monde (everybody) works like 'he'. mon = my, ton = your. Before a vowel the silent n comes back and joins the next word: mon ami, ton ami. This linking is called liaison.
points: il / elle forms end in a silent t: veut, peut, doit.
tout le monde = everybody (literally 'all the world'). It takes the il form: Tout le monde veut le voir.
mon = my, ton = your (to a friend). Both are nasal.
Liaison: a silent consonant is pronounced when the next word starts with a vowel and they belong together: mon ami ('mo-nami').
Questions can just use your voice: Ton ami peut le porter ?
vocab: il veut / elle peut / il doit
he wants / she can / he must
drills: Tout le monde veut le voir.
My friend wants to invite you.
Your friend has to carry it.
Does your friend want to carry it?
